submit_script:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=aniso-v1-unit-geometry-r3
#SBATCH --comment=20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8
#SBATCH --account=SDILLON1
#SBATCH --partition=standard
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=6G
#SBATCH --output=/tmp/hpc3-20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8-slurm-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=/tmp/hpc3-20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8-slurm-%j.err
#SBATCH --chdir=/tmp

set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 027
export HPC3_RUN_DIR=/pub/sdillon1/codex-runs/pfgg-anisotropic-cahn-hoffman-v1/20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8
export HPC3_INPUT_DIR="$HPC3_RUN_DIR/input"
export HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR="$HPC3_RUN_DIR/results"
export HPC3_RUN_ID=20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8
hpc3_retry() {
  local attempt=1
  until "$@"; do
    if [ "$attempt" -ge 40 ]; then return 1; fi
    printf "HPC3 transient I/O failure (attempt %d/40): %s\n" "$attempt" "$*" >&2
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    sleep 15
  done
}
hpc3_retry mkdir -p "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR" "$HPC3_RUN_DIR/status"
task_suffix="${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID:-single}"
task_results="$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR/$task_suffix"
hpc3_retry mkdir -p "$task_results"
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
: "${TMPDIR:?Slurm did not provide TMPDIR}"
export HPC3_WORK_DIR="$TMPDIR/hpc3-$HPC3_RUN_ID-$task_suffix"
stage_hpc3_input() {
  rm -rf "$HPC3_WORK_DIR"
  mkdir -p "$HPC3_WORK_DIR"
  tar -xzf "$HPC3_INPUT_DIR/source.tar.gz" -C "$HPC3_WORK_DIR"
}
hpc3_retry stage_hpc3_input
cd "$HPC3_WORK_DIR"/.
marker="$HPC3_RUN_DIR/status/final-$task_suffix.json"
output_patterns=(output)
task_results="$TMPDIR/hpc3-result-stage-$HPC3_RUN_ID-$task_suffix"
rm -rf "$task_results"
mkdir -p "$task_results"
node_log_stem="hpc3-20260911T004050Z-nogit-3e2ea8-slurm-${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
preserve_node_logs() { hpc3_retry cp -f "/tmp/$node_log_stem.out" "/tmp/$node_log_stem.err" "$HPC3_RUN_DIR/logs/"; }
copy_result_item() { src="$1"; dest="$2"; partial="$dest.partial.$$"; rm -rf "$partial"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"; cp -R "$src" "$partial"; rm -rf "$dest"; mv "$partial" "$dest"; }
scratch_emergency_finalize() {
  original_rc=$?; trap - EXIT; set +e
  if [ ! -f "$marker" ]; then
    for pattern in "${output_patterns[@]}"; do while IFS= read -r -d "" item; do rel="${item#./}"; hpc3_retry copy_result_item "$item" "$task_results/$rel"; done < <(find . -path "./$pattern" -print0 2>/dev/null); done
    partial_archive="$TMPDIR/partial-results-$task_suffix.tar.gz"
    (cd "$task_results" && tar -czf "$partial_archive" .)
    hpc3_retry cp -f "$partial_archive" "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR/partial-results-$task_suffix.tar.gz" || true
    preserve_node_logs || true
    emergency_tmp="$marker.tmp.$$"
    printf '{"run_id":"%s","job_id":"%s","task":"%s","application_exit":%d,"finalization_exit":1,"complete":false,"partial":true}\n' "$HPC3_RUN_ID" "${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}" "$task_suffix" "$original_rc" >"$emergency_tmp"
    mv "$emergency_tmp" "$marker"
  fi
  exit "$original_rc"
}
trap scratch_emergency_finalize EXIT
start_time=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
hostname_value=$(hostname)
module list 2>"$task_results/modules.txt" || true
printf "run_id=%s\njob_id=%s\nhost=%s\nstart=%s\n" "$HPC3_RUN_ID" "${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}" "$hostname_value" "$start_time" >"$task_results/provenance.txt"
set +e
bash run.sh
app_rc=$?
set -e
finalize_rc=0
checksum_scopes=("$task_suffix")
for pattern in "${output_patterns[@]}"; do
  while IFS= read -r -d "" item; do
    rel="${item#./}"
    hpc3_retry mkdir -p "$task_results/$(dirname "$rel")" || finalize_rc=$?
    hpc3_retry copy_result_item "$item" "$task_results/$rel" || finalize_rc=$?
  done < <(find . -path "./$pattern" -print0 2>/dev/null)
done
local_archive="$TMPDIR/results-$task_suffix.tar.gz"
(cd "$task_results" && tar -czf "$local_archive" .) || finalize_rc=$?
hpc3_retry cp -f "$local_archive" "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR/results-$task_suffix.tar.gz" || finalize_rc=$?
rm -rf "$task_results"
hpc3_retry mkdir -p "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR/$task_suffix" || finalize_rc=$?
checksum_scopes=("results-$task_suffix.tar.gz")
checksum_file="$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR/checksums-$task_suffix.sha256"
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then (cd "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR" && for scope in "${checksum_scopes[@]}"; do find "$scope" -type f -print0; done | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum) >"$checksum_file" || finalize_rc=$?; else (cd "$HPC3_OUTPUT_DIR" && for scope in "${checksum_scopes[@]}"; do find "$scope" -type f -exec shasum -a 256 {} \;; done) >"$checksum_file" || finalize_rc=$?; fi
end_time=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
preserve_node_logs || finalize_rc=$?
complete=false; [ "$app_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$finalize_rc" -eq 0 ] && complete=true
tmp_marker="$marker.tmp.$$"
printf '{"run_id":"%s","job_id":"%s","task":"%s","host":"%s","start":"%s","end":"%s","application_exit":%d,"finalization_exit":%d,"complete":%s}\n' "$HPC3_RUN_ID" "${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}" "$task_suffix" "$hostname_value" "$start_time" "$end_time" "$app_rc" "$finalize_rc" "$complete" >"$tmp_marker"
mv "$tmp_marker" "$marker"
[ "$finalize_rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$finalize_rc"
exit "$app_rc"
